sloka: इत्यक्त्वा तु वरारोहा मणिप्रवरमद्भुतम् ।प्रायच्छत् परमोद्विग्ना वाचा मां संदिदेश ह ।। ५.५८.१०२ ।।।।
transliteration: ityaktvā tu varārohā maṇipravaramadbhutam ।prāyacchat paramodvignā vācā māṁ saṁdideśa ha ।। 5.58.102 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having said so, the noble lady delivered a wonderful jewel with supreme message to me in a sorrowful mood.
